Yes — once I've saved a bookmark, the details are mine. Whatever I reviewed and especially anything I changed myself should stay put, even if the original page later renames itself or swaps its picture. The whole reason I fix up a title is to make it recognizable *to me*; it would be maddening if I came back later and my careful wording had been quietly overwritten by whatever the site decided to call itself this month.

So my answer is a clear yes: don't silently replace what I've got. My saved copy should hold onto the title, description, icon, and picture as I left them.

The one nuance I'd add: if a page really has changed and I happen to *want* the fresh details, I'd like that to be something I choose — like a "refresh from the page" I can reach for on purpose — not something that just happens to me behind my back. But the default, and the thing that matters most, is that my reviewed and edited details are kept and never overwritten on their own.
